purpose: Reclassify the independent 19 nested /thumbs/ references using frozen v15 provenance, local payload bytes, Pillow validation, and source15 manifest capture metadata.
supersedes: ../v3/supplement-classification-v3.json only for the nested_preview_references classification; existing 19 overlay records and Karazhan/3368/MEDIA counts are unchanged.

classification_rule.local_payload_available: true only when the exact v15 provenance route is kind=image, transformed=false, local output exists, derived/source hashes and lengths match, and Pillow verifies plus loads the bytes.
classification_rule.capture_date_known: true only when source15 build-manifest files[index].actual_timestamp is a 14-digit timestamp; HTML reference lines alone do not count.
classification_rule.late_claim: true only for an actual capture timestamp after the v15 anchor; no HTML-only late inference is made.
classification_rule.temporal_class: capture timestamp before 2008 -> pre_2008; 2008 timestamp at or before anchor -> baseline_2008; later 2008 -> late_2008; later years -> post_2008; missing/invalid -> unknown.
classification_rule.dynamic_full_relation: The frozen gallery page addshots() constructs sourceDirectory + filename + N.jpg, printPages() derives the thumbnail by replacing .jpg with -thumb.jpg, and omegaLightBox() loads shotList[N]. A parent #fragment is resolved through currentShotNumber - fragment only when reverseOrder=false; conflicting parent fragments remain review candidates and are never treated as proof that the thumb and fragment-selected full are the same bytes.
